title: Derived pullback is left adjoint to derived direct image for ringed spaces
statement: Let $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal B)$ be a morphism of ringed spaces [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define $Lg^*E:=\mathcal O_X\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{g^{-1}\mathcal B}g^{-1}E$ using [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and let $Rg_*$ be the right derived functor of $g_*$ [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Then $Lg^*:D(\mathcal B)\rightleftarrows D(\mathcal O_X):Rg_*$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is an adjoint pair, with natural bifunctorial bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(Lg^*E,F)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal B)}(E,Rg_*F)$.
